title: Add buffer reuse and copy on resize.

target.summary: In `prepare_asset`, buffer reuse checks `prev.buffer_descriptor == source_asset.buffer_description` without accounting for the actual CPU data length in `source_asset.data`. If CPU data size changes or does not match the descriptor size, a buffer of mismatched size is reused, causing `write_buffer` to trigger a GPU validation crash.
notes: faulty check comparing buffer descriptors instead of CPU data size before buffer reuse
stores unadjusted buffer descriptor rather than descriptor with actual CPU data size
call site where CPU data is written into the reused buffer of potentially mismatched size
definition of the prepare_asset method whose buffer reuse logic is faulty
